classification: analysis-only AGX allocation lifetime and TVB discovery probe

analysis.compare: Every CPU-mapped allocation dumped immediately before the first submission is paired by handle, GPU address, and size with its dump after command-buffer completion. Changed byte ranges are reported without consulting a reference image or retained mask output.
analysis.primaryQuestion: Does any captured CPU mapping expose TA-written TVB, generated-vertex, tile-list, or coefficient-setup data after completion?
analysis.secondaryQuestion: Which allocation handles and byte ranges are GPU-written, and which command-stream pointers join those allocations?

failClosed: Reject a non-exact opt-in environment value.
Reject a missing post-completion hook symbol.
Reject a probe command buffer that does not complete successfully.
Reject a missing or size-mismatched pre/post allocation pair.
Do not interpret an allocation as TVB solely because it changed; require a command-pointer, structure, or controlled-input join.
